RSBV Learning & Launch Hub

Interactive App Tutorials & How to Publish Online for Free

Tutorial 1 🪄

Write or Auto-Generate a Script

Enter any topic in Box 1 and click Write Full Script, or paste your own script and scale it up to 15:00 Max.

Tutorial 2 🎨

Generate Storytelling Art

Pick an art style (Cinematic, Storybook, Neon, Watercolor) and click Generate Story Art for All Scenes or upload photos.

Tutorial 3 🎵

Voice, Music & Subtitles

Select an AI narrator voice, test the Background Music Generator, and pick your Karaoke Highlight Color.

Tutorial 4 🏷️

Custom Video Watermark

Personalize your channel name, tagline, icon or uploaded logo, corner or center-stamp position, opacity, and brand color.

Tutorial 5 🎬

720p–4K Quality & Export

Choose your aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 21:9) and quality preset (up to 4K 60fps), then click One-Click Export.

Easiest • 30 Seconds Free

1. Netlify Drop (Drag & Drop)

  1. Click the green ⬇ Download index.html button above to save your app file.
  2. Put that index.html file inside a new empty folder on your computer named rsbv-app.
  3. Open app.netlify.com/drop in your browser and drag the rsbv-app folder onto the page—your live link is ready immediately!
Result: https://your-site-name.netlify.app
Best Permanent Free URL Free Forever

2. GitHub Pages

  1. Create a free account on github.com and click New Repository (name it rsbv-video-editor, set to Public).
  2. Click uploading an existing file, drop in your downloaded index.html, and click Commit changes.
  3. Go to Settings → Pages, select the main branch, and click Save.
Result: https://username.github.io/rsbv-video-editor/
Global CDN + Custom Domain Free Hobby Tier

3. Vercel or Cloudflare Pages

  1. Sign in to vercel.com or pages.cloudflare.com with your GitHub account.
  2. Select your rsbv-video-editor repository and click Deploy (no build command needed for static HTML).
  3. Every time you edit index.html on GitHub, your live site updates automatically in seconds.
Result: https://rsbv-video-editor.vercel.app
